description: Presidential Secretariat - Ammending the Duties & Functions assigned to Minister of Rehabilitation. Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs (No.41) Minister of Southern Development (No.44) & Minister of Public Enterprise Development (No.30) Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 & 1936/51 of 15.10.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and contains detailed portfolio responsibilities for two ministerial positions (Minister of Prison Reforms and Rehabilitation, Resettlement & Hindu Religious Affairs; and Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development), including specific duties, functions, departments, and laws to be implemented. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both the government person (the President) and detailed ministerial portfolio descriptions.
